about.quote: The hard part is no longer writing code. It's understanding real problems.

items.question: What if the software doesn't work?
items.answer: If the system doesn't meet the agreed acceptance criteria, you don't pay. It's that simple. This model works because we have an incentive to understand your problem thoroughly before building anything.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a solution?
items.answer: Most internal tools are delivered in days to weeks, not months. The timeframe depends on the complexity of the workflow and integration requirements. We focus on delivering quickly and iterating based on actual usage.

items.question: Do you handle hosting and maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. Ongoing hosting, maintenance, and improvements are available as optional services after the initial delivery. You decide what level of support makes sense for your needs.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: We use modern, proven technologies that fit the problem at hand. The tech stack is selected for maintainability, reliability, and integration capabilities—not resume building. You'll never be locked into proprietary frameworks.
